🎥🎬: Smallville (2001)

Before he became Superman, Clark Kent was a young man growing up in Smallville, Kansas, struggling to understand his extraordinary abilities and the mysterious origins of his arrival on Earth. Raised by Jonathan and Martha Kent, Clark tries to live a normal life while hiding powers that set him apart from everyone around him.

As Clark grows older, he faces dangerous enemies, discovers secrets about his Kryptonian heritage, and forms complicated relationships with Lana Lang, Chloe Sullivan, and his future rival, Lex Luthor. Strange meteor rocks also transform ordinary people into dangerous threats, forcing Clark to protect his hometown while keeping his identity secret.

Through friendship, betrayal, heartbreak, and impossible choices, Clark gradually discovers what it means to be a hero. His journey from an uncertain teenager to the man destined to become Superman is shaped by the people he loves and the responsibility that comes with his powers.

source_details.synopsis: Smallville is an American superhero television series developed by writer-producers Alfred Gough and Miles Millar, based on the DC Comics character Superman created by Jerry Siegel and Joe Shuster. The series was produced by Millar/Gough Ink, Tollin/Robbins Productions, DC Entertainment, and Warner Bros. Television. It follows the coming-of-age adventures of teenage Clark Kent (Tom Welling) in his fictional hometown of Smallville, Kansas, before he formally becomes the Man of Steel.
